pages.headline: October index performance diverged sharply
pages.lead: NSE Indices' October total-return dashboard records Nifty 50 up 1.95%, Nifty 500 down 0.75%, Midcap 150 down 3.69% and Smallcap 250 down 5.78%.
analysis: The 2.70 percentage-point gap between Nifty 50 and Nifty 500 suggests weaker performance beyond the headline large-cap index.
RBI raised its repo rate to 5.50% on 7 October; October CPI later reached 6.09% year on year, complicating the equity discount-rate backdrop.
pages.risk_note: October data are completed-month returns, not November-to-date or forecast returns. None of these figures is an investment signal.

pages.headline: Price pressure and policy tightening meet
pages.lead: MoSPI's October CPI showed 6.09% year-on-year inflation, with food inflation at 8.94%; September industrial production grew 6.7%.
analysis: The RBI's October MPC raised the policy repo rate from 5.25% to 5.50%. That is a 25-basis-point change, not a 25% rate increase.
Compare CPI, IIP and repo-rate readings on their own dates; their frequency, definitions and base years are not interchangeable.
pages.risk_note: Food inflation is provisional, and IIP estimates may be revised. The indicators do not establish a certain stock-market reaction.

pages.headline: Nifty 50 gained 1.95% in October
pages.lead: Official NSE Indices total-return data show Nifty 50 +1.95% over one month, -5.29% over three months and -9.45% over one year as at 31 October.
analysis: The index's reported 1-year volatility is 13.90%, with a P/E of 19.30 and price-to-book of 2.83 on the dashboard's as-of date.
The one-month advance alongside negative longer-period returns argues against extrapolating a trend from a single positive month.
pages.risk_note: Returns shown are total-return-period summaries; they are not a verified daily candlestick series, support level or trading forecast.

pages.headline: Bank Nifty stabilised while smaller stocks fell
pages.lead: October total-return readings: Nifty Bank +0.10%, Nifty 50 +1.95%, Nifty 500 -0.75%, Nifty Midcap 150 -3.69% and Smallcap 250 -5.78%.
analysis: Nifty Bank's October P/E is 12.23 versus 19.30 for Nifty 50; industry composition makes a direct valuation conclusion inappropriate.
On a matched 31 October dashboard basis, large-cap leadership did not extend uniformly into the broader market.
pages.risk_note: An index comparison is not a stock-selection rule. All returns use the NSE dashboard's stated total-return convention.

pages.headline: Index concentration is not the same as breadth
pages.lead: Nifty 500 lost 0.75% in October while its equal-weight variant lost 5.12%, a gap of 4.37 percentage points on the official dashboard.
analysis: The equal-weight measure gives smaller constituents more impact than capitalization-weighted Nifty 500, offering a concentration proxy.
Actual NSE advance-decline counts, cash-market FII/DII flows and individual-stock breadth require their own dated source tables.
pages.risk_note: Do not label equal-weight underperformance an official advance-decline breadth statistic; institutional flow numbers are withheld.

pages.headline: IT outperformed as metals and capital goods fell
pages.lead: October NSE sector-index total returns showed Nifty IT +18.06%, Nifty Pharma +2.60%, Nifty PSU Bank +2.73% and Nifty Metal -7.51%.
analysis: Nifty Capital Goods fell 7.23%, Auto fell 3.31%, while the Nifty Healthcare Index gained 1.93% over the same published month.
The wide sector dispersion is consistent with heterogeneous earnings and risk expectations; actual catalysts need issuer evidence.
pages.risk_note: These are index returns rather than individual stock returns. Sector index composition and reporting convention can differ.

pages.headline: Large-cap valuation reference: Nifty 50
pages.lead: Nifty 50 traded at an index P/E of 19.30 and price-to-book of 2.83 as at 31 October, with a reported dividend yield of 1.42%.
analysis: The same dashboard reports 13.90% annualized one-year volatility and a 1.95% total-return advance in October.
TCS reported consolidated Q2 FY27 revenue from operations of Rs 73,188 crore in its NSE iXBRL filing, on an INR reporting basis.
pages.risk_note: TCS is an illustrative issuer filing, not a ranked recommendation; company valuation needs audited price and share-count inputs.

pages.headline: Mid-cap valuation requires cash-flow discipline
pages.lead: The Nifty Midcap 150 returned -3.69% in October; its published 31 October P/E is 26.27 and one-year volatility is 16.75%.
analysis: That P/E exceeds the Nifty 50's 19.30 by 6.97 points, but business mix and growth expectations differ across constituents.
Persistent Systems reported Q2 FY27 revenue of $487.6 million, 20.0% year-on-year USD growth and 15.0% EBIT margin.
pages.risk_note: Persistent is an illustrative issuer, not proof of Nifty Midcap 150 membership or a mid-cap stock recommendation.

sources.title: Persistent Q2 FY27 audited results release

pages.headline: Small-cap multiples remain sensitive to risk
pages.lead: The Nifty Smallcap 250 index lost 5.78% in October; its P/E was 31.28 and one-year volatility 18.14% in the official dashboard.
analysis: Compared with Nifty 50, the small-cap proxy shows higher P/E and one-year volatility, with a deeper one-month loss.
Liquidity, free-float market capitalization, debt coverage and cash conversion remain mandatory tests for individual companies.
pages.risk_note: Index ratios describe the segment aggregate only. No verified top-five small-cap ranking or issuer-specific valuation is asserted.

pages.headline: Three technology issuers, different reporting bases
pages.lead: TCS filed Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue of Rs 73,188 crore in INR, while Persistent and Coforge reported USD revenue growth of 20.0% and 40.1% respectively.
analysis: NSE's TCS iXBRL filing gives INR revenue, so TCS is excluded from the USD growth comparison chart; no cross-currency growth ranking is asserted.
Persistent's USD revenue was $487.6 million; Coforge reported $652.2 million. Their margins and growth bases require separate checks.
pages.risk_note: Different issuer reporting currencies and acquisition effects prevent a directly comparable three-stock revenue-growth ranking.

pages.headline: Strategy Lab: inflation meets market dispersion
pages.lead: The observed combination is a 5.50% repo rate, 6.09% October CPI inflation, +1.95% Nifty 50 October return and -5.78% Smallcap 250 return.
analysis: Scenario 1: sticky inflation could raise financing costs; investigate real interest sensitivity and working-capital exposure.
Scenario 2: easing inflation could lower discount-rate pressure, but earnings and valuations must independently support conclusions.
pages.risk_note: These conditional scenarios are educational stress tests, not predicted future returns, price targets or trade entries.

pages.headline: Data calendar: next checks before December
pages.lead: MoSPI scheduled FY27 Q2 GDP data for 30 November 2026, and the September IIP release said October IIP is due the same day.
analysis: The RBI's next scheduled MPC meeting is 2-4 December 2026; the November CPI release is scheduled for 14 December.
Treat calendar events as checkpoints for updating scenario assumptions, never prefill a future result or policy decision.
pages.risk_note: Schedule dates can change; confirm each event from the issuing authority before any automatic issue publication.

sources.title: MoSPI advance schedule for FY27 Q2 GDP release

pages.headline: Risk map: protect against false certainty
pages.lead: October's 1.95% Nifty 50 gain coexisted with declines of 0.75% for Nifty 500, 3.69% for Midcap 150 and 5.78% for Smallcap 250.
analysis: Compare company liquidity, leverage and earnings revisions within matched reporting periods, not one-month price movements.
Monitor whether index leadership broadens, and re-check after GDP, inflation and RBI policy releases rather than precommitting.
pages.risk_note: No customer allocation, target return or index level is recommended from these limited observations.

pages.headline: Methods, sources and publication limitations
pages.lead: All index figures in this draft come from the NSE Indices October 2026 total-return dashboard; CPI, IIP and repo data cite official releases.
analysis: TCS consolidated INR revenue is supported by an NSE iXBRL filing; Persistent and Coforge USD figures come from separate issuer Q2 communications.
Market dates, data types and source identities are disclosed; official website citations do not replace saved source bytes or human approval.
pages.risk_note: No issuer financial assessment substitutes personalized advice. Release requires logo, visual, source-byte, editorial and Telegram proof.
